name: Rusy ne protiv Jascherok
source:
Once again vile lizards descended upon the lands of Hyperborea, and their plans are as wicked and perverse as ever! It's time to take a swig of the fortifying waters of Baikal and repel these reptile temptresses! We'll push them against the wall and show them the true might of our heroic spears!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715650/Humans_are_not_that_against_Lizardwomen/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
邪恶的蜥蜴再次降临Hyperborea的土地，他们的计划一如既往的邪恶和反常！是时候喝一口贝加尔湖的强化水并击退这些爬行动物诱惑了！我们要把他们推到墙上，让他们见识一下我们英勇长矛的真正威力！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715650/Humans_are_not_that_against_Lizardwomen/]Steam[/url]]
